mods._note: Script Corrupted_Drycha戴查氏族长.lua (Workshop pack of 2026-10-28): the listener ChieftainUnlock calls kill_ariel() when the ariel recruit ritual starts; ChieftainRecruitAI performs that ritual for an AI Drycha from rank 10. kill_ariel() goes through wh_dlc05_wef_wood_elves, wh_dlc05_wef_argwylon, wh2_dlc16_wef_sisters_of_twilight and wh2_dlc16_wef_drycha and sets character_unlocking.character_data.ariel.has_spawned. The game's wh3_main_legendary_characters.lua gives Ariel to the Sisters, Orion or Durthu after their first forest ritual.
knownIssues+: It takes the game's own Ariel away from the Wood Elves: when Drycha recruits Ariel as her first chieftain – an AI Drycha does so as soon as she is rank 10 – Ariel is removed from all four Wood Elf factions and can no longer be unlocked. Playing Orion, Durthu or the Sisters of Twilight you lose her, or never get her (script read 2026-11-10).

mods._note: Script @n_slaaneshvictories_script.lua: is_corrupted() is true when a character of the lady's subtype is in the player's faction; the turn-start listener then raises her count and triggers <short>_sub_1..3.
installNotes+: Played as one of the ladies it knows yourself (Alarielle, Morathi, the Fay Enchantress, Elspeth, the Sisters of Twilight, Hellebron, Katarin, Repanse, Miao Ying, Khalida), the mod counts her as already won over: on your first three turns her events give her +2, +4, then +6 Slaanesh corruption in the province she is in; on turn 3 "Corrupt their kingdom" adds Slaanesh's Harem (+8 Slaanesh corruption in all your provinces, +150 relations with the other ladies' factions), "Corrupt their soul" nothing more (script and tables read 2026-11-10).

mods._note: Script @n_slaaneshvassals_non_slaanesh_script.lua: is_corrupted() is true for a lady whose subtype is in the player's faction, so her n_gen_<short>_ dilemmas can be drawn from turn 1.
installNotes+: Played as one of the ladies it knows yourself (Alarielle, Morathi, the Fay Enchantress, Elspeth, the Sisters of Twilight, Hellebron, Katarin, Repanse, Miao Ying), the mod counts her as vassalized or confederated: from turn 1, about every second or third turn (30 % chance, +5 % per turn without one), a dilemma about her offers +10 % replenishment for a turn, 1,000 gold, a random ancillary for 3,000 gold or Slaanesh's Blade and a Personal Sycophant for 25,000 gold; no downside (script and tables read 2026-11-10).
